procedure_file: extraction_procedure_social_addendum_v1.4_social science Classes 6-10 on top of procedure v2.md

second_method.method: independent count of answer-side keys (60 numbered keys 1-28, 30-61 + 1 unnumbered match block under 'Match the Following (Easy):' = q29)

count_gate.note: This LBA prints NO difficulty distribution table (searched all 200 pages) -> quota_table 'absent' (differs from the prompt's pinned 'difficulty_only'; reported at READY). Question side numbered 1-61 monotonic, no gaps, no duplicates; answer side 1-28, [match block], 30-61. Difficulty per question: easy 45, average 1, difficult 15, untagged 0.

method_notes: Pages: Q side lesson heading pdf 3 (LO list), q1-18 pdf 4, q19-31 pdf 5, q32-55 pdf 6, q56-61 + figure pdf 7. A side: 'Key Answers / Lesson 1' heading pdf 106 (below the end of Lesson 25's question side), keys 1-26 pdf 107, 27-41 pdf 108 (q41 bullets spill to 109), 42-51 pdf 109, 52-58 pdf 110, 59-61 pdf 111. The LBA prints no page folios: printed_page = pdf_page (offset 0) by convention so folio_scan can run.

Sections (no numerals printed; -sN- by printed order): s1 'Choose the correct answers and write them below (Easy)' q1-10 mcq; s2 'Fill in the blanks with suitable answers (Easy)' q11-20 fill; s3 'State true or false to the following questions (Easy)' q21-28 true_false; s4 '29. Match the Following (Easy)' q29 match (heading printed on the question's own numbered line; the answer side prints it as a section heading with no '29.' label); s5 one mark q30-39 vsa; s6 two marks q40-47 sa; s7 three marks q48-55 sa; s8 four marks q56-61 la (q61 picture-labelling task typed sa by form).

MARKS: s5-s8 headings print '(one/two/three/four marks questions)' -> marks 1/2/3/4, marks_source 'section_header' (v2 §5, addendum §6.7 printed marks win). This DIFFERS from the prompt's pin 'marks not printed per question in any of the three' and is reported at READY for the coordinator's ruling; s1-s4 print none -> null + 'unassigned' + 'marks ambiguous in source — no marks printed'.

DIFFICULTY: section-heading tags '(Easy)' on s1, s2, s3, s5 -> difficulty_source 'section_header' (v1.4 §14.7); q29 and q40-61 carry their own tags (q47, q51, q56, q60 wrapped to the next line). No untagged question.

T/F stems print an answer space ' — (__)' after the statement: removed from text (layout, not content), kept in text_as_printed. Fill blanks kept as printed underscores. Stem spacing before '?'/'.' de-glued in text only (text_as_printed verbatim).

KEYS: MCQ letter+text, all letters agree with their text except q10 'A) Bull' vs option A 'Bull / Ox' (letter kept, 'key text paraphrases option'). Bullet keys: one step per printed bullet; q50 and q52 print 'Examples: …' on a new line inside the last bullet (kept as a line in answer.value, part of that bullet's step); q47 bullet is one sentence wrapped across two lines (joined). q61 key printed as a bracketed instruction '[For this, student should colour a picture of a fish and label: head, fins, tail, gills, body]' -> stored verbatim.

MATCH q29: key prints each row as 'left-letter) item  right-letter) item' in a two-column table (pdf 108; wrapped cells read from the render); pairs stored with the key's own wording, letters kept in answer_as_printed. Row i) Hawk -> 'h) Eat the dead animals and keep clean' differs from column-B h) -> flagged. Answer locator y = the 'Match the Following (Easy):' heading.

FIGURE (v1.4 §14.10 inventory): pdfimages lists 6 embedded images in the whole LBA (pdf 1 logo; pdf 7 q61 fish; pdf 16 L3 q80; pdf 28 L6 q74; pdf 51 L11 q63; pdf 106 L25 q79 Karnataka outline); pdfplumber finds no curves/vector figures; answer side carries none. q61 figure -> stimulus st-evs-4-01-q61 with its crop asset (render 150 dpi, crop_bbox = the image box in PDF points). The crop file sits in images/evs-4-01/stimuli/ because gate 2.20's orphan-image scan only counts question-level assets, and a question-level 'figure' asset is a strict v1.4 FAIL — gate gap reported (no description of the picture is stored, prompt §1 types).

LO: an 8-bullet unnumbered LO list (pdf 3); no question carries an LO number -> learning_outcomes [] + 'no LO mapped' on every question (prompt §1a). TOPIC: topic_ids ['evs-4-01-t00'], topic_source 'chapter', confidence 'high' (ruling R-E3; EVS map v1 evs-4-01 has exactly one section t00).
No exam-appearance markers, no Kannada, no shifted/displaced keys. Source typos kept verbatim (q6 'frim', q32 'havan snake', option D 'dog' lower-case).
